payload.title: CLI publish derives the publication kind and projection function from the site, not env
payload.description: On 5.7.0 'papyrus ops content publish' on an S3-projection site falls back to Pretext revalidation (error: PAPYRUS_PUBLIC_SITE_BASE_URL or publicSite.baseUrl required) because projection_configured() only reads the PAPYRUS_PUBLICATION_KIND env var, which the content-actions Lambda has but an operator shell doesn't. Derive the publication kind (s3-projection vs pretext) and the content-actions function name from the site's papyrus.config.ts / deployed backend outputs (amplify_outputs custom outputs), so publish/unpublish re-project with no env. Workaround: PAPYRUS_PUBLICATION_KIND=s3-projection PAPYRUS_CONTENT_ACTIONS_FUNCTION=<name>.
